case.summary: Customer C08106 reported a $128.33 online purchase (transaction 3583227) on 2016-12-29 as unauthorized. The transaction used a new device (Firefox 47.0) not previously associated with the account and was four times the cardholder's median transaction amount of $26.62 across 216 prior transactions. An episode of eight transactions totaling $384.43 occurred over three days using this new device, with the flagged transaction as the second in the sequence. The account has three prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases, and eight structurally similar closed cases retrieved by shared device and matching pattern were all confirmed fraud with no false alarms. The card-not-present-new-device pattern matched at 0.57 strength. Based on the customer's direct denial, the anomalous transaction size, the new device usage, the cluster of activity within a short timeframe, and the consistent history of confirmed fraud on this account, this is a strong fraud case. Confidence is high.
